examples.text: uyyānabhūmiṃ gantvāna, pokkharaññā samantato, tassā tīre tuvaṃ ṭhāsi, harite saddale subhe.

58003.meaning1: thoughts about sounds; intention regarding sounds

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā, rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.

58004.meaning1: recognition of sound; perception of sound
58004.commentary: (NIDD1a) rūp'ārammaṇaṃ ārabbha uppannā saññā rūpasaññā. saddasaññ'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. idaṃ tassā'y'eva ārammaṇato nāmaṃ. ārammaṇānaṃ vuttattā cakkhusamphassaj'ādi-vatthūni'pi vuttān'eva honti.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, se āyatane veditabbe yattha cakkhu ca nirujjhati, rūpasaññā ca nirujjhati, se āyatane veditabbe yattha sotaṃ ca nirujjhati, saddasaññā ca nirujjhati
kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha'y'imā, bhikkhave, saññā, rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.

58007.meaning1: generated by sounds; produced by noises

examples.text: tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā saddasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.

58008.meaning1: pleased with sounds; enjoying noises; happy with sounds

examples.text: rūpavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti. sadd'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā saddaratā saddasammuditā. saddavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti.

rūpavicāro loke… saddavicāro loke… gandhavicāro loke… rasavicāro loke… phoṭṭhabbavicāro loke… dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.

rūpavitakko loke… saddavitakko loke… gandhavitakko loke… rasavitakko loke… phoṭṭhabbavitakko loke… dhammavitakko loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.

58012.meaning2: who knows the meaning of various sounds
58012.meaningLit: who knows the meaning of sounds

examples.text: veneyyavasena h'ettha vacanabhedo kato'ti veditabbo. atha vā sante na kurute'ti sante na sevatī'ti attho, yathā rājānaṃ sevatī'ti etasmiñ'hi atthe rājānaṃ piyaṃ kurute'ti saddavidū mantenti.

58013.meaning1: change, fading and ending of sounds; alteration, disappearance and cessation of noises

examples.text: rūpavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti. sadd'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā saddaratā saddasammuditā. saddavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti.

58015.meaning1: believes; has faith; has confidence; has conviction (in)

examples.text: idh'āvuso bhikkhu saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.
satthā mūlasiriṃ āmantetvā, jānāsi etan'ti pucchitvā, na jānāmī'ti vutte, pitā te ānandaseṭṭhī'ti vatvā asaddahantaṃ, ānandaseṭṭhi puttassa te pañca mahānidhiyo ācikkhāhī'ti ācikkhāpetvā saddahāpesi

58019.meaning1: should be believed; should be trusted (in)
58019.meaningLit: to caused the heart to be placed

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā akusalā imassa lokassa akusalā parassa lokassa, akusalā māradheyyassa akusalā amāradheyyassa, akusalā maccudheyyassa akusalā amaccudheyyassa, tesaṃ ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.

58020.meaning1: having faith; having confidence; with conviction

examples.text: sace musā na bhaṇasi, sace pāṇaṃ na hiṃsasi, sace adinnaṃ n'ādiyasi, saddahāno amaccharī, kiṃ kāhasi gayaṃ gantvā, udapāno'pi te gayā'ti.
dānañ'ca yuddhañ'ca samānam'āhu, app'āpi santā bahuke jinanti, appam'pi ce saddahāno dadāti, ten'eva so hoti sukhī paratthā'ti.
satthā mūlasiriṃ āmantetvā, jānāsi etan'ti pucchitvā, na jānāmī'ti vutte, pitā te ānandaseṭṭhī'ti vatvā asaddahantaṃ, ānandaseṭṭhi puttassa te pañca mahānidhiyo ācikkhāhī'ti ācikkhāpetvā saddahāpesi

ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhū, sadd'ādhibhū, gandh'ādhibhū, ras'ādhibhū, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhū, dhamm'ādhibhū, adhibhū, anadhibhūto, adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobbhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye. evaṃ kho, āvuso, anavassuto hotī'ti.

58029.meaning1: overpowered by sounds; overwhelmed by noises

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhūto, sadd'ādhibhūto, gandh'ādhibhūto, ras'ādhibhūto, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhūto, dhamm'ādhibhūto, adhibhūto, anadhibhū, adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā. evaṃ kho, āvuso, avassuto hoti.

58030.meaning1: field of sounds; realm of noises

examples.text: cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? rūp'āyatanaṃ sadd'āyatanaṃ gandh'āyatanaṃ ras'āyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabb'āyatanaṃ dhamm'āyatanaṃ

58034.meaning2: having made a noise, having shouted

58036.meaning1: enjoying sounds; taking pleasure in noises; fond of sound

examples.text: sotaṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya, sadd'ārāmaṃ… ghānaṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya gandh'ārāmaṃ… jivhā kho, māgaṇḍiya, ras'ārāmā rasaratā rasasammuditā. sā tathāgatassa dantā guttā rakkhitā saṃvutā, tassā ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

58038.meaning1: providing a sound; arranging something to hear

examples.text: sadd'ūpahāro nāma amanāpikaṃ saddaṃ upasaṃharati bhayānakaṃ bheravaṃ, imaṃ sutvā uttasitvā marissatī'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. taṃ sutvā uttasati, āpatti thull'accayassa.

58039.commentary: (APt) dīpinivisaye saddūlo īrito, saratī'ti saddūlo, ūlo, do canto, saddena ulati gacchatī'ti vā saddūlo.

examples.text: atha kho milindo rājā khaggaparivārito viya gajo, garuḷaparivārito viya nāgo, ajagaraparivārito viya kotthuko, mahiṃsaparivuto viya accho, nāg'ānubaddho viya maṇḍūko, saddūl'ānubaddho viya migo, ahituṇḍikasamāgato viya pannago, majjārasamāgato viya undūro, bhūtavejjasamāgato viya pisāco… bhīto…
idh'āvuso bhikkhu saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
asubh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi ca mattaññuṃ, saddhaṃ āraddhavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃ'va pabbataṃ.
sātiyesu anassāvī, atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. atha kho āyasmā saddho yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

58043.meaning1: name of a monk; son of Sudatta

examples.text: ko nām'āyaṃ, subhūti, bhikkhū'ti? saddho nām'āyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu, sudattassa upāsakassa putto, saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito'ti.

58044.meaning1: faithful family; household which has confidence

examples.text: yā'pi'ssa bhariyā saddhā saddhakulā ānītā sā'pi kālaṅ'katā, aññāssa bhariyā assaddhā assaddhakulā ānītā.

58045.meaning1: good teaching; true doctrine; true nature of things; (comm) the five precepts, ten precepts, four foundations of mindfulness etc.

examples.text: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.
dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato āgato imaṃ saddhamman'ti
kathañ'ca, mahānāma, ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti?

58047.meaning1: non-deterioration of the good teaching; non-decline of the true doctrine

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhaddo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti? ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṃ hotī'ti?

58048.meaning1: respecting the true doctrine; giving weight to the real Dhamma
58048.commentary: (ANa) saddhammagarū'ti nava lok'uttaradhamme garuke katvā cattāro paccaye lāmakato gahetvā ṭhitaparisā.

examples.text: sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihaṃsu viharanti ca, tathā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.

58049.meaning1: fact of valuing the real Dhamma; fact of giving weight to the true teaching

examples.text: katame cattāro? kodhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, makkhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, lābhagarutā na saddhammagarutā, sakkāragarutā na saddhammagarutā. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro asaddhammā.

58050.meaning1: roaming within the good qualities; with the (seven) good qualities as natural habitat
58050.commentary: (SNa) sattasaddhammagocarā'ti saddhā hirī ottappaṃ bāhusaccaṃ āraddhavīriyatā upaṭṭhitassatitā paññā'ti ime satta saddhammā gocaro etesan'ti sattasaddhammagocarā.

examples.text: pañcakkhandhe pariññāya, satta saddhammagocarā, pasaṃsiyā sappurisā, puttā buddhassa orasā.

58051.meaning1: continuity of the good teaching; longevity of the true doctrine
58051.commentary: (VINa) saddhammaṭṭhitiyā'ti tividho saddhammo, pariyattisaddhammo, paṭipattisaddhammo, adhigamasaddhammo'ti. tattha piṭakattayasaṅgahitaṃ sabbam'pi buddhavacanaṃ pariyattisaddhammo nāma. terasa dhutaguṇā, cuddasa khandhakavattāni, dve-asīti mahāvattāni, sīlasamādhivipassanā'ti ayaṃ paṭipattisaddhammo nāma. cattāro ariyamaggā cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni nibbānañ'cā'ti ayaṃ adhigamasaddhammo nāma.

examples.text: tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca, saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinay'ānuggahāya.

58052.meaning1: discourse on the true teaching; explanation of the nature of things

examples.text: sukho buddhānam'uppādo, sukhā saddhammadesanā, sukhā saṅghassa sāmaggī, samaggānaṃ tapo sukho.

58053.meaning1: on a fixed course towards the true teaching

58054.meaning1: deterioration of the good teaching; decline of the true doctrine

examples.text: ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṃ hoti? ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṃ hotī'ti?

58055.meaning1: fake version of the true doctrine; counterfeit of the good teaching
58055.commentary: (SNa) saddhammappatirūpakan'ti dve saddhammappatirūpakāni adhigama-saddhammappatirūpakañ'ca pariyatti-saddhammappatirūpakañ'ca. idaṃ vipassanāñāṇassa upakkilesajātaṃ adhigamasaddhammappatirūpakaṃ nāma. tisso pana saṅgītiyo anāruḷhaṃ dhātukathā ārammaṇakathā asubhakathā ñāṇavatthukathā vijjākaraṇḍako'ti imehi pañcahi kathāvatthūhi paribāhiraṃ guḷhavinayaṃ guḷhavessantaraṃ guḷhamahosadhaṃ vaṇṇapiṭakaṃ aṅgulimālapiṭakaṃ raṭṭhapālagajjitaṃ āḷavakagajjitaṃ vedallapiṭakan'ti abuddhavacanaṃ pariyatti-saddhamma-ppatirūpakaṃ nāma.

examples.text: na tāva, kassapa, saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti yāva na saddhammappatirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati. yato ca kho, kassapa, saddhammappatirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati, atha saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti.

58056.meaningLit: discourse on the counterfeit of the good teaching

58057.meaning1: understanding the true teaching; comprehending the good doctrine

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo'ti.

58058.meaning1: persuasion to accept a true doctrine; convincing to follow a righteous teaching

examples.text: santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ atthi paro loko'ti paraṃ saññāpeti, s'āssa hoti saddhammasaññatti. tāya ca pana saddhammasaññattiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.

58059.meaning1: possessing good qualities; full of positive characteristics

examples.text: sappuriso, bhikkhave, saddhammasamannāgato hoti, sappurisabhatti hoti, sappurisacintī hoti, sappurisamantī hoti, sappurisavāco hoti, sappurisakamm'anto hoti, sappurisadiṭṭhi hoti, sappurisadānaṃ deti.

58060.meaning1: hearing the true teaching; listening to the good doctrine

examples.text: katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ? bhagavato ahaṃ, bhante, dassanassa atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato, saddhammasavanass'āhaṃ, bhante, atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato, saṅghass'āhaṃ, bhante, upaṭṭhānassa atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato. imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato'ti.

58064.meaning1: hearing the true teaching; listening to the good doctrine

examples.text: kiccho manussapaṭilābho, kicchaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ, kicchaṃ saddhammassavanaṃ, kiccho buddhānam'uppādo.
taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto. so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhaṃ'p'atthi saddhā, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi vīriyaṃ, mayhaṃ'p'atthi vīriyaṃ
alam'eva saddhāpabbajitena kulaputtena vīriyaṃ ārabhituṃ
aniccā hi calā saddhā, evaṃ diṭṭhā hi sā mayā, rajjanti'pi virajjanti, tattha kiṃ jiyyate muni.
assaddhassa, bhikkhave, saddhākathā dukkathā, dussīlassa sīlakathā dukkathā, appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā, maccharissa cāgakathā dukkathā, duppaññassa paññākathā dukkathā.

58073.meaning1: a person in whom faith has arisen; who has great confidence
58073.meaning2: who's faith has arisen (for); who are confident (in)
58073.commentary: (MNa) saddhājāto'ti okappaniyasaddhāya jātasaddho. (MNt) saddhā jātā etassā'ti saddhājāto, agyāhitātipakkhepena jāta-saddassa pacchāvacanaṃ. evametan'ti adhimuccanaṃ okappaniyasaddhā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, saddhājāto upasaṅkamati, upasaṅkamanto payirupāsati, payirupāsanto sotaṃ odahati, ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati

58074.meaning1: fit to be believed; should be trusted

examples.text: ye'pi tava sotabbaṃ saddhātabbaṃ maññissanti, te'pi anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissanti, seyyathā'pi te satthikā.

58075.meaning1: with faith as one's companion; accompanied with confidence; full of faith

examples.text: saḷ'eva phass'āyatanāni bhikkhavo, asaṃvuto yattha dukkhaṃ nigacchati, tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisuṃ, saddhādutiyā viharant'ānavassutā.

58076.meaning1: offered with faith; (comm) in the results of actions
58076.commentary: (DNa) saddhādeyyānī'ti kammañ'ca phalañ'ca idhalokañ'ca paralokañ'ca saddahitvā dinnāni. ayaṃ me ñātī'ti vā, mitto'ti vā, idaṃ paṭikarissati, idaṃ vā tena katapubban'ti vā, evaṃ na dinnānī'ti attho. evaṃ dinnāni hi na saddhādeyyāni nāma honti.

examples.text: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti

58077.meaning1: wealth that is confidence; treasure of faith

examples.text: satt'imāni, bhikkhave, dhanāni. katamāni satta? saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hirīdhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ

58078.meaning1: firm in faith; unwavering in confidence
58078.commentary: (ANa) saddh'ādhimuttānan'ti saddhāya adhimuttānaṃ, balavasaddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vakkalitthero aggo'ti dasseti. aññesaṃ hi saddhā vaḍḍhetabbā hoti, therassa pana hāpetabbā jātā. tasmā so saddh'ādhimuttānaṃ aggo'ti vutto. vakkalī'ti pan'assa nāmaṃ.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saddh'ādhimuttānaṃ yadidaṃ vakkalī'ti.

58079.meaning1: who has attained the path of stream entry through faith

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.

58080.meaning1: gaining of faith; acquiring of confidence

examples.text: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhiṃ, sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā.

58081.meaning1: characteristics of confidence; manifestation of faith

examples.text: kacci pan'āyaṃ, subhūti, saddho bhikkhu sudattassa upāsakassa putto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito sandissati saddh'āpadānesū'ti?

58082.meaning1: who ordained out of confidence; who went forth with faith

examples.text: alam'eva saddhāpabbajitena kulaputtena vīriyaṃ ārabhituṃ

58083.meaning1: nurtured by faith; fortified by confidence; matured by faith

examples.text: yassa kassaci, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ…

58084.meaning1: power that is confidence; strength of faith

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañca balāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu saddhābalaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ

58085.meaningLit: discourse on the strength of faith

58086.meaning1: measure of faith; degree of confidence
58086.commentary: (MNa) yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattan'ti iminā yesaṃ añño ariyadhammo n'atthi, tathāgate pana saddhāmattaṃ pemamattam'eva hoti. te vipassakapuggalā adhippetā. vipassakabhikkhūnañ'hi evaṃ vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā nisinnānaṃ dasabale ekā saddhā ekaṃ pemaṃ uppajjati.

examples.text: evaṃ svākkhāte, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattaṃ sabbe te saggaparāyanā'ti.
tathāgate c'assa saddhāmattaṃ hoti pemamattaṃ, api c'assa ime dhammā honti

58087.meaning1: mere faith; simple faith; faith alone

examples.text: siyā kho pana, bhante, idh'ekaccassa āyasmato evam'assa, kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayam'āyasmā nissāya nekkhamm'ādhimutto'ti.

tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī'ti pavedeti, addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatī'ti.

58088.meaning1: trustworthy; in whom one has confidence
58088.meaningLit: in whom one places the heart
58088.commentary: (THIa) sā bhikkhuniṃ upāgacchiṃ, yā me saddhāyikā ahū'ti yā mayā saddhātabbā saddheyyavacanā ahosi, taṃ bhikkhuniṃ s'āhaṃ upagacchiṃ upasaṅkamiṃ, paṭācārātheriṃ saddhāya vadati.

examples.text: sā bhikkhuniṃ upagacchiṃ, yā me saddhāyikā ahu, sā me dhammam'adesesi, khandh'āyatanadhātuyo.

58090.meaning1: attainment of faith; achievement of confidence

examples.text: yo ca kho, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro assaddhe saddhāsampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, dussīle sīlasampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, maccharī cāgasampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, duppaññe paññāsampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, ettāvatā kho, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ katañ'ca hoti paṭikatañcā'ti.

58091.meaning1: full of confidence; with good faith; having faith

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ

58092.meaning1: what is called the state of being full of faith

58094.meaning1: liberated through faith; attained through confidence; epithet of a stream-enterer or higher
58094.commentary: (MNa) saddhāvimutto'ti saddhāya vimutto. so'pi vuttanayen'eva chabbidho hoti. ten'ev'āha, idh'ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan'ti, yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā… no ca kho yathā diṭṭhippattassa. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo saddhāvimutto'ti (pu. pa. 208).

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?

katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo saddhāvimutto? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, tathāgate c'assa saddhā niviṭṭhā hoti mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā.

58095.meaning1: growth in faith; increase in confidence

examples.text: katamā tisso? saddhāvuddhi, sīlavuddhi, paññāvuddhi, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vuddhiyo'ti.

58096.meaning1: with faith as the trunk; having confidence as a trunk
58096.commentary: (THa) anavajjadhammānaṃ ādāne saddhā hattho etassā'ti, saddhāhattho (ANa) saddhāhattho'ti saddhāmayāya soṇḍāya samannāgato.

examples.text: sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.

58097.meaning1: power of faith; faculty of confidence
58097.commentary: (ANa) saddh'indriyaṃ bhāvetī'ti-ādīsu saddhā'va attano saddhādhure ind'aṭṭhaṃ karotī'ti saddh'indriyaṃ.

examples.text: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. vīriyindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

58098.meaning1: ending of faith; cessation of the faculty of confidence
58098.commentary: (SNa) saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānantī'ti dukkhasaccavasena na pajānanti. saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānantī'ti samudayasaccavasena na pajānanti. evaṃ nirodhaṃ nirodhasaccavasena, paṭipadaṃ maggasaccavasenā'ti. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, vīriy'indriyaṃ nappajānanti …

58099.meaning1: leading to the ending of faith; going to the cessation of the faculty of confidence
58099.commentary: (SNa) saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānantī'ti dukkhasaccavasena na pajānanti. saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānantī'ti samudayasaccavasena na pajānanti. evaṃ nirodhaṃ nirodhasaccavasena, paṭipadaṃ maggasaccavasenā'ti. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, vīriy'indriyaṃ nappajānanti …
